---
title: "Publications"
---

The table below is generated from `works.bib` and supports instant search and column sorting.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.min.js"></script>

<div id="pub-load-status">Loading publications from works.bib...</div>

<figure class="chart-figure" aria-label="Bar chart: publications per year">
	<canvas id="pub-chart" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart showing number of publications per year"></canvas>
	<figcaption id="pub-chart-caption" class="chart-caption"></figcaption>
</figure>

<div id="pub-filters" style="display:none"></div>

<table id="pub-table" class="display accessible-table" style="width:100%" aria-label="Publications">
	<caption class="visually-hidden">Publications with year, title, authors, venue, type, and link.</caption>
	<thead>
		<tr>
			<th scope="col">Year</th>
			<th scope="col">Title</th>
			<th scope="col">Authors</th>
			<th scope="col">Venue</th>
			<th scope="col">Type</th>
			<th scope="col">Link</th>
		</tr>
	</thead>
	<tbody></tbody>
</table>

<script>
const drawBarChart = (canvasEl, labels, values, { rotateLabels = false, barColor = null } = {}) => {
	const isDark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
	const primary = isDark ? "#fac800" : "#990000";
	const textColor = isDark ? "#c9c9c9" : "#444444";
	const gridColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)";
	const axisColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
	const bar = barColor || primary;

	const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
	const W = Math.max(canvasEl.parentElement?.clientWidth || 640, 320);
	const padB = rotateLabels ? 72 : 48;
	const H = 300;
	const padL = 48, padR = 16, padT = 30;
	const cW = W - padL - padR;
	const cH = H - padT - padB;

	canvasEl.width = W * dpr;
	canvasEl.height = H * dpr;
	canvasEl.style.width = W + "px";
	canvasEl.style.height = H + "px";

	const ctx = canvasEl.getContext("2d");
	ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

	const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);
	const niceMax = Math.ceil(maxVal / 5) * 5 || 5;
	const nTicks = 5;

	for (let t = 0; t <= nTicks; t++) {
		const v = (t / nTicks) * niceMax;
		const y = padT + cH - (v / niceMax) * cH;
		ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
		ctx.lineWidth = 1;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
		ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, y);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
		ctx.textAlign = "right";
		ctx.fillText(Math.round(v), padL - 6, y + 4);
	}

	const n = labels.length;
	const slot = cW / n;
	const barW = Math.max(slot * 0.65, 4);
	const barOffset = (slot - barW) / 2;

	labels.forEach((lbl, i) => {
		const val = values[i];
		const bH = Math.max((val / niceMax) * cH, 0);
		const x = padL + slot * i + barOffset;
		const y = padT + cH - bH;

		ctx.fillStyle = bar;
		ctx.fillRect(x, y, barW, bH);

		if (val > 0) {
			ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
			ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(val, x + barW / 2, Math.max(y - 5, padT + 12));
		}

		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(x + barW / 2, padT + cH + 10);
		if (rotateLabels) {
			ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 4);
			ctx.textAlign = "right";
		} else {
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
		}
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
		ctx.fillText(lbl, 0, 0);
		ctx.restore();
	});

	ctx.strokeStyle = axisColor;
	ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.moveTo(padL, padT);
	ctx.lineTo(padL, padT + cH);
	ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, padT + cH);
	ctx.stroke();
};

const renderPubChart = (rows) => {
	const canvas = document.getElementById("pub-chart");
	const caption = document.getElementById("pub-chart-caption");
	if (!canvas) return;

	const yearCounts = {};
	rows.forEach(({ year }) => {
		if (year) yearCounts[year] = (yearCounts[year] || 0) + 1;
	});

	const years = Object.keys(yearCounts).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
	const counts = years.map((y) => yearCounts[y]);

	drawBarChart(canvas, years, counts, { rotateLabels: years.length > 10 });

	if (caption) {
		caption.textContent = `Publications per year: ${years.map((y) => `${y} (${yearCounts[y]})`).join(", ")}.`;
	}
};

const cleanField = (value) => {
	if (!value) return "";
	const asText = String(value)
		.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
		.replace(/[{}]/g, "")
		.replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+\s*/g, "")
		.replace(/\s+/g, " ")
		.trim();

	const decode = document.createElement("textarea");
	decode.innerHTML = asText;
	return decode.value;
};

const parseAuthors = (rawAuthors) => {
	if (!rawAuthors) return "";
	return cleanField(rawAuthors)
		.split(/\s+and\s+/i)
		.map((name) => name.trim())
		.filter(Boolean)
		.join(", ");
};

const entryLink = (fields) => {
	const doi = cleanField(fields.doi || fields.DOI);
	const url = cleanField(fields.url || fields.URL);
	if (doi) return `https://doi.org/${doi}`;
	return url;
};

const escapeRegex = (value) => String(value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const createDataTable = (selector, options) => {
	if (typeof window.DataTable === "function") {
		return new window.DataTable(selector, options);
	}

	if (window.jQuery?.fn?.DataTable) {
		return window.jQuery(selector).DataTable(options);
	}

	return null;
};

const enableBasicColumnSorting = (tableElement, { numericColumns = [], disabledColumns = [], defaultOrder = null } = {}) => {
	const headers = Array.from(tableElement.querySelectorAll("thead th"));
	const tbodyElement = tableElement.querySelector("tbody");
	if (!tbodyElement || headers.length === 0) return;

	const rowsForColumn = (columnIndex) =>
		Array.from(tbodyElement.querySelectorAll("tr")).map((row) => {
			const cell = row.children[columnIndex];
			const raw = (cell?.textContent || "").trim();
			const numeric = Number(raw.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ""));
			return {
				row,
				raw,
				normalized: numericColumns.includes(columnIndex) && Number.isFinite(numeric)
					? numeric
					: raw.toLowerCase()
			};
		});

	const sortByColumn = (columnIndex, direction) => {
		const rows = rowsForColumn(columnIndex);
		rows.sort((a, b) => {
			if (a.normalized < b.normalized) return direction === "asc" ? -1 : 1;
			if (a.normalized > b.normalized) return direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
			return 0;
		});
		tbodyElement.replaceChildren(...rows.map(({ row }) => row));
		headers.forEach((header, index) => {
			header.dataset.sortDir = index === columnIndex ? direction : "";
			header.setAttribute("aria-sort", index === columnIndex ? (direction === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none");
		});
	};

	headers.forEach((header, index) => {
		if (disabledColumns.includes(index)) return;
		header.tabIndex = 0;
		header.style.cursor = "pointer";
		header.setAttribute("aria-sort", "none");

		const onSort = () => {
			const nextDirection = header.dataset.sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
			sortByColumn(index, nextDirection);
		};

		header.addEventListener("click", onSort);
		header.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
			if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
				event.preventDefault();
				onSort();
			}
		});
	});

	if (defaultOrder) {
		sortByColumn(defaultOrder.column, defaultOrder.direction);
	}
};

const parseBibEntries = (text) => {
	const entries = [];
	const normalized = String(text || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
	let index = 0;

	const skipWhitespace = () => {
		while (index < normalized.length && /\s/.test(normalized[index])) {
			index += 1;
		}
	};

	const readUntil = (terminator) => {
		const start = index;
		while (index < normalized.length && normalized[index] !== terminator) {
			index += 1;
		}
		return normalized.slice(start, index);
	};

	const readBalancedBlock = (openChar, closeChar) => {
		let depth = 1;
		const start = index;
		while (index < normalized.length) {
			const char = normalized[index];
			if (char === openChar) depth += 1;
			if (char === closeChar) depth -= 1;
			index += 1;
			if (depth === 0) break;
		}
		return normalized.slice(start, index - 1);
	};

	const parseFields = (body) => {
		const fields = {};
		let i = 0;

		const readFieldValue = () => {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === "{") {
				i += 1;
				let depth = 1;
				const start = i;
				while (i < body.length) {
					const char = body[i];
					if (char === "{") depth += 1;
					if (char === "}") depth -= 1;
					i += 1;
					if (depth === 0) break;
				}
				return body.slice(start, i - 1);
			}

			if (body[i] === '"') {
				i += 1;
				const start = i;
				while (i < body.length) {
					if (body[i] === '"' && body[i - 1] !== "\\") break;
					i += 1;
				}
				const value = body.slice(start, i);
				i += 1;
				return value;
			}

			const start = i;
			while (i < body.length && body[i] !== ",") {
				i += 1;
			}
			return body.slice(start, i).trim();
		};

		const skipFieldWhitespace = () => {
			while (i < body.length && /\s/.test(body[i])) {
				i += 1;
			}
		};

		while (i < body.length) {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (i >= body.length) break;

			const keyStart = i;
			while (i < body.length && /[\w\-]/.test(body[i])) {
				i += 1;
			}
			const key = body.slice(keyStart, i).trim();
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] !== "=") {
				break;
			}
			i += 1;
			const value = readFieldValue();
			if (key) fields[key] = value;
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === ",") {
				i += 1;
			}
		}

		return fields;
	};

	while (index < normalized.length) {
		const at = normalized.indexOf("@", index);
		if (at === -1) break;
		index = at + 1;
		skipWhitespace();

		const typeStart = index;
		while (index < normalized.length && /[A-Za-z]/.test(normalized[index])) {
			index += 1;
		}
		const entryType = normalized.slice(typeStart, index).toLowerCase();
		skipWhitespace();
		if (normalized[index] !== "{") {
			continue;
		}
		index += 1;

		const key = readUntil(",").trim();
		if (normalized[index] === ",") index += 1;
		const body = readBalancedBlock("{", "}");
		const entryTags = parseFields(body);

		entries.push({ entryType, citationKey: key, entryTags });
	}

	return entries;
};

const loadPublications = async () => {
	const status = document.getElementById("pub-load-status");
	const tbody = document.querySelector("#pub-table tbody");
	const filters = document.getElementById("pub-filters");

	const yearLabel = document.createElement("label");
	yearLabel.htmlFor = "pub-year-filter";
	yearLabel.textContent = "Year: ";

	const yearFilter = document.createElement("select");
	yearFilter.id = "pub-year-filter";
	yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by year");
	yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "pub-table");
	yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>';
	yearLabel.appendChild(yearFilter);

	const typeLabel = document.createElement("label");
	typeLabel.htmlFor = "pub-type-filter";
	typeLabel.textContent = "Type: ";

	const typeFilter = document.createElement("select");
	typeFilter.id = "pub-type-filter";
	typeFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by type");
	typeFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "pub-table");
	typeFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>';
	typeLabel.appendChild(typeFilter);

	try {
		const response = await fetch("works.bib");
		if (!response.ok) {
			throw new Error(`Could not load works.bib (HTTP ${response.status})`);
		}

		const bibText = await response.text();
		const entries = parseBibEntries(bibText);

		const rows = entries.map((entry) => {
			const fields = entry.entryTags || {};
			const year = cleanField(fields.year || "");
			const title = cleanField(fields.title || "");
			const authors = parseAuthors(fields.author || "");
			const venue = cleanField(fields.journal || fields.booktitle || fields.publisher || "");
			const type = cleanField(entry.entryType || "");
			const link = entryLink(fields);

			return { year, title, authors, venue, type, link };
		});

		rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0));

		renderPubChart(rows);

		const years = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.year).filter(Boolean))]
			.sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
		const types = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.type).filter(Boolean))]
			.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

		years.forEach((year) => {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = year;
			option.textContent = year;
			yearFilter.appendChild(option);
		});

		types.forEach((type) => {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = type;
			option.textContent = type;
			typeFilter.appendChild(option);
		});

		filters.replaceChildren(yearLabel, typeLabel);

		tbody.innerHTML = rows
			.map((row) => {
				const safeLink = row.link
					? `<a href="${row.link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View publication: ${row.title}">View</a>`
					: "";

				return `
					<tr>
						<td>${row.year}</td>
						<th scope="row">${row.title}</th>
						<td>${row.authors}</td>
						<td>${row.venue}</td>
						<td>${row.type}</td>
						<td>${safeLink}</td>
					</tr>
				`;
			})
			.join("");

		const table = createDataTable("#pub-table", {
			pageLength: 25,
			order: [[0, "desc"]],
			columnDefs: [
				{ targets: 0, type: "num", orderable: true },
				{ targets: [1, 2, 3, 4], orderable: true },
				{ targets: 5, orderable: false }
			],
		});

		if (!table) {
			enableBasicColumnSorting(document.getElementById("pub-table"), {
				numericColumns: [0],
				disabledColumns: [5],
				defaultOrder: { column: 0, direction: "desc" }
			});
			status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} publications from works.bib. DataTables did not load, so basic column sorting is enabled.`;
			return;
		}

		const applyFilters = () => {
			const yearValue = yearFilter.value;
			const typeValue = typeFilter.value;

			table
				.column(0)
				.search(yearValue ? `^${escapeRegex(yearValue)}$` : "", true, false);
			table
				.column(4)
				.search(typeValue ? `^${escapeRegex(typeValue)}$` : "", true, false);
			table.draw();
		};

		yearFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		typeFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		filters.style.display = "block";

		status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} publications from works.bib.`;
	} catch (error) {
		status.textContent = `Unable to load publications: ${error.message}`;
	}
};

loadPublications();
</script>
